name: Elkanah (Samuel's father)
title: The Faithful Levite
summary: Elkanah was a Levite from the hill country of Ephraim who was the father of the prophet Samuel. He was a godly man who traveled annually to Shiloh to worship the Lord, and he showed great care for his barren wife Hannah during her suffering.

keyEvents.title: Annual Pilgrimage to Shiloh
keyEvents.description: Elkanah faithfully traveled year after year from his hometown to Shiloh to worship and offer sacrifices to the Lord, God of Hosts.

keyEvents.title: Comforting His Barren Wife
keyEvents.description: Elkanah showed deep love for Hannah and comforted her when she wept over her barrenness, giving her a double portion of the sacrifice.

keyEvents.title: Supporting Hannah's Vow to God
keyEvents.description: When Hannah made a vow to give her son to the Lord for his entire life, Elkanah supported her decision and let her stay at home until the child was weaned.

keyEvents.title: Dedicate Samuel to the Lord's Service
keyEvents.description: Elkanah and Hannah brought the young Samuel to the temple in Shiloh and gave him to the priest Eli to serve the Lord all his days.

keyEvents.title: Blessed with More Children
keyEvents.description: After Samuel was given to the Lord's service, Eli blessed Elkanah and Hannah, and they had more sons and daughters.
